subject: music
title: Texture Types
welcome_lead: Mono, homo, poly — how parts layer in music.
final_note: Texture answers: how many things are happening at once?

concepts.def: Many voices on the same note.
A single line within a texture.

walkthroughs.body_html: Monophonic means one melodic line. A solo singer with no backing, or a whole choir singing in unison, is monophonic.
Homophonic = melody on top, chords or bass underneath. This is the most common pop and rock texture — a singer with a guitar.
Polyphonic means several independent melodies at once. A round like Frere Jacques is polyphonic. So is most of Bach's music.
